review_comments: It was Resurrection Day(Easter Sunday) eve and I had to look sharp and refined for the special service at my church. However, being occupied all of Saturday, I had to squeeze in a salon visit late at night, at 8:25 PM. My experience revealed the stark difference in customer service between two branches of Naturals Salon.  First, I headed to the Kothanur branch, hoping for a quick haircut and beard grooming. Despite the barber's willingness to take my appointment, the manager declined the service, citing it was closing time. This refusal came after making me wait for 10 minutes—a disappointing experience that left me feeling overlooked.  On the other hand, the Hennur branch demonstrated exceptional customer service and humanity. Despite my 30-minute delay (due to aiding an elderly woman who fell while crossing the road), they graciously held my appointment. Their warmth and humility were touching, and I was welcomed by the stylist, ASIF. He listened to my story and didn’t show even the slightest frustration about working late. His kindness and professionalism stood out as he diligently completed the haircut and beard trim.  Both ASIF and the branch manager, TRESA, deserve commendation for prioritizing customer needs. Their actions reflect what outstanding service should be.  In my experience, the Hennur branch of Naturals Salon truly excels in delivering exceptional service with a personal touch. They have earned my trust and appreciation, and I wholeheartedly recommend them!

Cool.” After everything, I was pointed down the menu which showed head shave and beard shave at the prices I mentioned at the top, which was double of what I expected (400 LKR).  They did list all the prices on the menu, so buyer beware.  Deceptive practices, but not fraudulent.  I just paid it because I didn’t do my due diligence and read down the whole menu.  776LKR is an insane price for a head and beard shave.  No AC or anything.  No head massage.  Nothing special about the shave, at all.  It was the same quality of picking a random place on the street, which would be less than half the cost. It would have been cheaper and better quality to just buy a Mach 3 Gillette razor (375LKR) from the first floor of the mall, and do it myself.  They didn’t even have any change for cash.  Lesson learned.

Also the salon was empty and you don't hv time to provide the requested service but has time to do a hair spa. Also he did not even wash my hair and blow dry it after cutting. You don't go to a place and she'll out Rs 350 just for a hair cut and do not expect a normal hair wash and blow dry it. It seems they have hired anyone who walked down the street. review_comments: They dont deserve any Start infact.  The worst salon i have been to and worst place. There was no electricity at all throughout. I color my hair regularly and i know when its not covered 100%.  She was so immature and unprofressional and started blabbering that i cannot see my vision is not clear. I dont recommend anyone to visit this salon for any service. they only try to upsell upsell upsell. they have a target to meet and they dont have any original products they dont open or show you the products they use. you cant make out if they are mixing water or anything else and cheating you - with advantage of no power. Horrible place and horrible staff.
